title: Mixed Event — The BEST Summer Ever! — Episode3 An Odd Sound

meta.Event Outline: The Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy first years arrive at the Seaside School. Finding themselves allocated to the same group for the school's annual presentation event, Honami, Saki, Emu, and Kohane put their showmanship skills to the test by performing a song from a musical.

rows.Line: Lodge Gym

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, is this a good spot for our instruments?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup. Drum on the left and the keyboard on the right!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But who would've known that this place had a keyboard and a drum kit!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, it's a little old, but they seem like more than enough for us.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I'll go grab some chairs and desks from one of the other classrooms. They might be nice to have while we're practicing...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll help you get them!
Lodge Classroom

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hey, Emu. What are you up to right now?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We're practicing for our presentation. My group decided to do a musical.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Oh, that sounds like fun♪
Mind if I watch you practice?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, of course.
I'd love it if you could see us perform!

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Voice
rows.Line: Emu, can you lend me a hand with this...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Coming!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Anyway, good luck, Emu!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! Thanks, Miku☆

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Lodge Gym

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Honami, Saki, we're all ready over here!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is there anything you need help with?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
We just about ready here too!
We checked over the sheet music and everything seems fine.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's nice that we were able to just buy the sheet music on our phones♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. We even got a hold of the song from that site, which I'm sure will be more than helpful while we practice it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, since we're all set, wanna start?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, wait! One second!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Saki, what's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Um, Kohane, I have a request for you... Can you sing a song for us?! Just once!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Y-You want me to sing...?
All by myself...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes! I've already heard Emu sing during one of her shows.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I wanna hear you sing too!!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'd like to as well... That is, if it's alright with you, Kohane. You don't have to if you don't want to.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thanks, Honami.
But it's okay. I will.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: How about I give you a sampling of one of the songs my team usually sings at events.
song00005_off_s

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
Her voice is so pretty...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. It's so clear and she's able to go across registers so effortlessly...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Her voice is like Ichika's, but something about it is a little different...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It's cute, but also really cool...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you for doing that, Kohane! I couldn't stop listening the minute you started singing.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
R-Really...?
I hope I didn't sound weird.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, you have such a pretty singing voice!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
You made it feel like we were at a live house just now♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Th-Thank you... I was a little nervous, so I wasn't sure that I'd be able to sing the way I usually do...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I also hardly ever sing for people that go to school with me... But I'm glad you liked it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, now that we've had a chance to hear Kohane sing, shall we try it once from the top? I'll count us in.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thanks, Hona!
We'll be counting on you too, Ms. Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Roger!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Here we go...
One, two, three, four...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Emu as Dorothy and Kohane as Amy...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I have a good groove going too. So does Saki. As long as we stay in rhythm like this, we should...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Huh? That's strange. I don't think this is how BEST SUMMER is supposed to sound...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Something feels off. Almost like the music isn't syncing up with the song... Am I doing something wrong...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I can't put my finger on it, but it's like our voices don't match what Honami and Saki are playing at all.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Huh? This doesn't feel right...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (But why? I'm not sure how to describe it, but this doesn't feel like a musical for some reason...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... Nice work, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What did you think, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... Hmmm...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's really hard for me to describe, but it's like we weren't doing a musical...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
You thought so too...?
I felt the same way. Something didn't feel quite right.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, me too...!
I did everything the sheet music said, but it's like I was doing something wrong for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, Saki, you didn't do anything wrong...! I felt that I wasn't singing right either, as if I was the one doing something wrong.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...
Yet based on what I heard, you were pitch-perfect, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I... I think I know what's wrong! I get that it's important not to make mistakes, but we might be focusing on that too much!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Musicals need to be more fun or more emotional, you know? We should focus more on bringing those emotions to the surface just before the climax.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Bring those emotions to the surface...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... I think staying in character is gonna be really important here. It's a musical, so we aren't just acting. We have to sing from our hearts.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Whenever I perform at a live house, I usually make small changes to the way I sing to match what the crowd wants to see. Is that sort of what you're talking about...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, that!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We can't just go up there and sing. We have to sing as Amy and Dorothy while working with the music, I think?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sing as Amy and Dorothy...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Not missing a beat while the rhythm keeps changing... That almost sounds like freeform jazz.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That may be a bit challenging, but I'd like to give it a try. Thank you for your insight, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. You're super welcome!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shall we try that once more while keeping Emu's advice in mind?

rows.Speaker: Kohane & Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll count us in again.
One, two, three, four.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That was amazing!
It's really starting to feel like a musical now!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank goodness...! But I still feel like we could sync up with Honami and Saki better. I never realized it was so hard to sing while in character.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, we're singing and playing much better, but we're still not quite there yet.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. But we're making good progress. For now, let's maintain this pace and just keep trying!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! Let's make this a super wonderhoy performance!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hm? What?! We've already spent an hour doing this?! We need to clean up soon before the other groups get here...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...!
We should hurry.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I wish we could practice more...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too. There just wasn't enough time...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Right...
I suppose we can all try to think of ways to get better in a short amount of time.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, let's do that☆
I'll go get the next group while I do.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, okay...!
Thanks, Emu!
Beach

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Hnng...
I can't find the right words to describe it to them...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Is everything okay, Emu?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, I'm okay.
Sorry about that. I wish we could've done better for you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <No, don't say that! I had fun, so chin up, Emu.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <No one ever gets it right the first time. You practice lots and lots for your shows too, don't you?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <So there's no need to worry or feel rushed. You practiced a lot today too, so you should get a good night's rest and try again tomorrow!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Is what KAITO told me one time☆>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow, KAITO really does know what to say in these kinds of situations!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Thanks for everything today, Miku.
I'm sure things will go better tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So will you come and watch us practice again?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Of course!
I'll be cheering you on, Emu♪>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks, Miku.
